title: Time-series charts drop empty date buckets and draw straight through them (a month with 0 revenue disappears from a 12-month trend)
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 4 Marketing (report comment 6444160853 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D11; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-f5gugw` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/4-marketing/`); track 3 Service (report comment 6444034183 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding S14; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-97u09k` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/3-service/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

- Executive Overview "Revenue Trend: Closed-won revenue over the last 12 months" plots 5 evenly spaced points (2026-04, 06, 07, 09, 10). May and August had 0 closed-won (read over the API: 8 closed-won deals) and are absent, so the smoothed area shows revenue in them. The same chart is on Sales Performance and CRM Overview (`an-admin-dashboard-executive_dashboard.png`).
- Customer Service "Daily Case Volume, last 30 days" skips zero days (Sep 30, Oct 1, …); its line reads 1 on them, and Sep 28 → Oct 7 takes the same width as Oct 26 → Oct 27 (`an-admin-dashboard-service_dashboard.png`, `svc-71-mgr-service-overview-full.png`).

**Who loses:** every trend a manager reads is distorted exactly where it matters (the gaps).

## Expected

A date-dimension series over a bounded window is zero-filled per bucket (or drawn on a true time axis with gaps shown as 0 / no line), so every month or day in the window appears.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "time series chart empty buckets zero fill date dimension missing months": 1 hit — #4033 (closed, bucket label dropped from rows). None reports the missing buckets.

**Reader who acts:** the analytics date bucketing / chart renderer owner.
